explanation: Zero everywhere except at D1 right after a trial where the agent chose a1, got a rare transition to S2 and was unrewarded: it then hits about 10, especially when the earlier trials were rewarded and it is early in the episode (trials ~15-50), and only about 5-7 later in the episode or when the rare loss repeats or follows other losses (0 after a long losing streak). An unrewarded a2-to-S2 common trial gives at most 1-4 at the next D1, an unrewarded a1-to-S1 common trial gives 0, and GO and D2 are always 0.
